newsitem.title: USA: Stockpile says Minor Metals cobalt was allocated.
newsitem.headline: Stockpile says Minor Metals cobalt was allocated.

text.p: The cobalt awarded by the U.S. Stockpile to Minor Metals, announced earlier Thursday, had already been allocated to the company but the latter was late signing off on the deal, Stockpile deputy administrator Robert O'Brien said.
Late Tuesday the Defense National Stockpile Agency, named seven companies that were awarded a total of 1.1 million pounds of cobalt.
Minor Metals had been allocated material Tuesday but had not signed off to agree officially to the deal in time to be included in the press announcement, O'Brien said.
Minor Metals' share will come from the 1.1 million pounds, and all the other winning bidders will still receive the full amount of metal originally awarded to them, O'Brien added.
